meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

You entered a zero on my son's essay a week ago, Hale, and Owen found out from his phone in the middle of class. Nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so who decided, and was Owen heard before you did it?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what you based it on.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

Turn the screen so I can read it myself. A document that fills up at 11:52 shows when words landed in it, Hale, not who wrote them. I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58, and I'll want that history sent to me in an email tonight.
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

Give me that page. Students get quotations wrong, Hale, and a bad citation is not a confession. Whatever happens from here, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, so tell me now whether anything is on his file today.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Thursday at 8:15, your room, no other students, and the vice-principal is the only other person there. I'll agree to that to put this behind him, Hale, not because of anything in that history. I want it in writing tonight that the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his file, under your own section 4.4.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in our meeting to a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15, with only the vice-principal present, and that its mark replaces the zero with nothing placed on Owen's record. I still require that agreement confirmed in writing, along with the version history you showed me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite with the vice-principal present, and she still wants written confirmation that nothing goes on his file plus a copy of the version history.
What moved her: "That line is not in Hamlet", because it was specific, tied to the essay itself, and something she could check with her own eyes.
What cost ground: nothing.
Try next time: when she asked whether anything was on his file that day, answer that question directly before offering the rewrite, since it was the one thing she asked that you left unanswered.
